Alfalfa Yield in Saudi Arabia.

Source: R/data.R
alfalfa.Rd

Alfalfa yields measured for a particular harvest in a field located in Saudi Arabia. The data is a modified version of the kayad.alfalfa data set in the agridat package.

Usage

alfalfa

Format

A sf object with 2677 rows and 2 columns:

  • yield: the alfalfa yield at the location (in tons per acre).

  • geometry: point-level geometry with a KSA-GRF17 / UTM zone 38N projection. Distances between locations are in meters.

Source

Ahmed G. Kayad, et al. (2016). Assessing the Spatial Variability of Alfalfa Yield Using Satellite Imagery and Ground-Based Data. PLOS One, 11(6). https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0157166

References

Wright K (2025). _agridat: Agricultural Datasets_. doi:10.32614/CRAN.package.agridat <https://doi.org/10.32614/CRAN.package.agridat>. R package version 1.26, <https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=agridat>.
